subject: chemistry
content: Two students use the same stock solution of ZnSO<sub>4</sub> and solution of CuSO<sub>4</sub>. The emf of one cell is 0.03 V higher than other. The conc. of CuSO<sub>4</sub> in the cell with higher emf value is 0.5 M. Find out the conc. of CuSO<sub>4</sub> in the other cell (2.203 RT/F = 0.06)
